name: Open Subtitles
description: Download subtitles from the internet to use with your media files. (Requires configuration) This fork adds a bulk season subtitle downloader.

versions.changelog:
- Correctly report "rate limited" instead of "no match found" for episodes skipped in the bulk season downloader once the daily OpenSubtitles download limit is reached.
- Pin build to Jellyfin.Common/Jellyfin.Controller 12.0.0 exactly (fixes PluginStatus.NotSupported on 12.0.0-based servers).
- Add bulk season subtitle downloader: pick a series and one or more seasons on the plugin settings page and download the best-matching English subtitle (perfect hash match preferred, highest download count as tiebreaker) for every episode in one click.
